source_text: Dominus locutus est ad Moysen. Dominus spiritus est; sermo Dei non secundum incapaces sed secundum potentiam loquentis intelligendus.
pass_a_gloss: Lord has-spoken to Moses. Lord spirit is; speech of-God not according-to incapable-ones but according-to power of-speaking-one to-be-understood.
pass_b_english: [[The Lord spoke to Moses >> Bible:Leviticus 6:1]]. [[The Lord is Spirit >> Bible:2 Corinthians 3:17]]; God’s speech is read by the Speaker’s power, not by our thin capacity.
